besluite.rede: A present-tense verb in a 'toe' clause before a past main clause is normal Afrikaans narrative, so the change is lateral (the same tense shift was dropped in an earlier round).
The present 'skryf' is generic (any book written later counts), and the perfect would narrow it to one specific past book, so the meaning moves.

besluite.fout: 'Inenting is wanneer' copies the English 'X is when' definition pattern.
